Department of Biochemistry

The Department of Biochemistry at Northfield University in Ontario, Canada trains undergraduate and graduate students in protein chemistry, molecular biology, analytical chemistry and laboratory methods. Faculty research includes peptide synthesis, enzyme kinetics, mass spectrometry and structural biology.
